exercises.title: Order the steps of a React update
exercises.problemHtml:
React serves UI like a restaurant kitchen: an order is placed (trigger), the cook prepares it (render), the dish is served (commit), then the customer sees it (browser paint). Put the steps in order.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
React phục vụ giao diện như bếp nhà hàng: khách gọi món (trigger), đầu bếp nấu (render), mang món ra (commit), rồi khách thấy món (trình duyệt vẽ). Hãy xếp các bước đúng thứ tự.

Mẹo: đọc hết các lựa chọn rồi mới chọn — các phương án sai đều là lỗi thật sinh viên hay mắc trong đề FE.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Order the steps of a React update — answer key

1. A user clicks "+" in a counter. Order what happens.
   Answer: a) The click handler calls setCount(c => c + 1) (trigger)  →  b) React calls Counter() again to get new JSX (render)  →  c) React compares the new JSX with the previous one  →  d) React updates only the changed text node in the DOM (commit)  →  e) The browser paints the new number
   Trigger → render → diff → commit → paint. / Trigger → render → so sánh → commit → vẽ.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Trigger (lần đầu hoặc setState) → React gọi component (render) → so sánh và áp thay đổi tối thiểu vào DOM (commit) → trình duyệt vẽ.

cauHoi.de: A user clicks "+" in a counter. Order what happens.

muc.noiDung: React compares the new JSX with the previous one
The browser paints the new number
React calls Counter() again to get new JSX (render)
React updates only the changed text node in the DOM (commit)

cauHoi.giaiThich:
Trigger → render → diff → commit → paint.

🇻🇳 Trigger → render → so sánh → commit → vẽ.

mistakesJson.loi: Nghĩ render = cập nhật DOM. Render chỉ là gọi component để tính JSX.
Nghĩ mọi lần render đều đổi DOM.

starterCodeJson.code:
# Render vs commit: true or false?

Answer in the panel on the left (no code needed).

1. Every render changes the DOM.
2. When a parent re-renders, its children re-render too (by default).
3. Rendering must be pure: no side effects such as fetching or changing the DOM.
4. setCount(count) with the same value always triggers a full DOM rewrite.
5. React keeps a DOM input's typed text when the surrounding JSX re-renders with the same structure.
6. In StrictMode (development), React may call your component twice to detect impure renders.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Render vs commit: true or false? — answer key

1. Every render changes the DOM.
   Answer: b) False
   If the JSX is the same, the commit step changes nothing. / Nếu JSX như cũ, bước commit không đổi gì.

2. When a parent re-renders, its children re-render too (by default).
   Answer: a) True
   Unless wrapped in React.memo with unchanged props. / Trừ khi bọc React.memo và props không đổi.

3. Rendering must be pure: no side effects such as fetching or changing the DOM.
   Answer: a) True
   Side effects go into event handlers or useEffect. / Tác dụng phụ đặt trong handler sự kiện hoặc useEffect.

4. setCount(count) with the same value always triggers a full DOM rewrite.
   Answer: b) False
   React may bail out; even if it renders, the commit finds nothing to change. / React có thể bỏ qua; kể cả có render thì commit cũng không thấy gì để đổi.

5. React keeps a DOM input's typed text when the surrounding JSX re-renders with the same structure.
   Answer: a) True
   Same element in the same place ⇒ React reuses the DOM node. / Cùng phần tử ở cùng vị trí ⇒ React dùng lại nút DOM.

6. In StrictMode (development), React may call your component twice to detect impure renders.
   Answer: a) True
   That is why you can see "render" logged twice in development. / Vì vậy ở development bạn có thể thấy "render" in hai lần.

exercises.title: See render vs commit: count renders without re-rendering
exercises.problemHtml:
Make the render/commit cycle visible. A useRef counts how many times Counter renders (a ref change does NOT trigger a render). "+1" changes state; "Same value" calls setCount(count), which React may skip entirely.

Requirements

  • #count shows the count; #renders shows "Renders: N" where N increments inside the component body via renders.current += 1.
  • #plus ⇒ count + 1; #same ⇒ setCount(count).
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Làm cho chu trình render/commit hiện ra. useRef đếm số lần Counter render (đổi ref KHÔNG gây render). "+1" đổi state; "Same value" gọi setCount(count), React có thể bỏ qua hoàn toàn.

Yêu cầu

  • #count hiện số đếm; #renders hiện "Renders: N", N tăng trong thân component qua renders.current += 1.
  • #plus ⇒ count + 1; #same ⇒ setCount(count).
